# Library

```{r}
#| label: library
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(broom)
library(kableExtra)

```

# Step 1
```{r}
#| label: import data
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

nhis_train <- read_csv("nhis_flu_train_21_22.csv") |> 
  select(-c(HHX, SRVY_YR, AFNOW, PREGNOW_A, CVDDIAG_A)) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(AGEP_A, PCNT18UPTC, PCNTLT18TC), as.factor)) %>%
  drop_na()

nhis_test <- read_csv("nhis_flu_test_23.csv") |> 
  select(-c(HHX, SRVY_YR, AFNOW, PREGNOW_A, CVDDIAG_A)) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(AGEP_A, PCNT18UPTC, PCNTLT18TC), as.factor)) %>%
  drop_na()

```

# Step 2: Using Random Forest
```{r}
#| label: ranger
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(ranger)


RF <- ranger(SHTFLU12M_A ~ ., data = nhis_train, probability = TRUE, importance = "impurity")

```

```{r}
#| label: AUC
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(pROC)
pred_RF <- predict(RF, data = nhis_test)

preds_RF <- data.frame(
  true = nhis_test %>% pull(SHTFLU12M_A),
  pred = pred_RF$predictions[,2]
)

ROC <- roc(preds_RF %>% pull(true),
           preds_RF %>% pull(pred))

ROC$auc
```

#Step 3: SuperLearner set-up
```{r}
#| label: SL-set-up
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(SuperLearner)

Y_train <- nhis_train %>% 
  mutate(SHTFLU12M_A = as.integer(SHTFLU12M_A)-1) %>%
  pull(SHTFLU12M_A)

X_train <- model.matrix(SHTFLU12M_A ~ ., data = nhis_train)[, -1] %>% data.frame()
X_test <- model.matrix(SHTFLU12M_A ~ ., data = nhis_test)[, -1] %>% data.frame()

```

```{r}
#| label: wrappers
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

listWrappers("SL")
```

```{r}
#| label: define-SL-algorithims
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

SL_algorithms <- list("SL.ranger", "SL.glm", "SL.gam")
```

# Step 4: Fit SuperLearner Model
```{r}
#| label: fit
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  


SL <- SuperLearner(Y_train, X_train, 
                   newX = X_test,
                   family = "binomial",
                   SL.library = SL_algorithms,
                   cvControl = SuperLearner.CV.control(V=3))

```

# Step 5: Exploring the Results
```{r}
#| label: prediction
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

preds_df <- data.frame(
  true = nhis_test %>% pull(SHTFLU12M_A),
  pred = SL$SL.predict
)

preds_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pred, fill = true)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "dodge")

```

```{r}
#| label: prediction-by-model
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

preds_sl_df <- SL$library.predict %>% as_tibble() %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), 
               names_to = "model", values_to = "pred") %>% 
  mutate(true = rep(nhis_test %>% pull(SHTFLU12M_A), each = length(SL_algorithms)))

preds_sl_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pred, fill = true)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~model)
```

```{r}
#| label: SL-breakdown
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

SL$coef
SL$cvRisk
```


```{r}
#| label: SL-auc
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  


library(pROC)

pred_wide <- SL$library.predict %>% as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(SHTFLU12M_A = nhis_test %>% pull(SHTFLU12M_A))

ROC_all <- roc(SHTFLU12M_A ~ SL.ranger_All + SL.glm_All + SL.gam_All,
               data = pred_wide)
map_dfr(ROC_all, function(x) x$auc)
```

```{r}
#| label: auc-SL-overall
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

ROC <- roc(preds_df %>% pull(true),
           preds_df %>% pull(pred))

ROC$auc
```

```{r}
#| label: SL-CI
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

ci.auc(ROC)
```
